# Fisk's Fleet

## Overview
Fisk's privateer fleet commands five captains across the Shattered Sea.
The captains share a berth, letters of marque, and a common supply route.

## Agenda
The fleet seeks a secure berth and recruits captains for the next crossing.

## People & Structure
The fleet is led by Fisk and five captains.
